notes: INSIDE half of the Grundl Slug Mortar: a heavy breech block with a round slug in it, a ribbed feed chute to the right (the ammo rack sits beside it), a big hatch with rivets, power coupling and five amber lamps. charge: a slug rolls in from the chute (frame 5 = seated and ready, lamps green); fire: the breech is empty. damaged: a lamp dead, the chute dented and leaking, sparks; disabled: a slug jammed half-way in the chute. Barrel layer grundl_slug_mortar_barrel: a massive banded barrel with rows of big rivets and a heavy muzzle ring; fire: a huge flash and recoil.
